    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractGridModel
    Base class for models: listener handling, fire helpers like Swing's AbstractTableModel, and a safe way to change data from any thread.
    CellContext
    Everything a CellRenderer needs to paint one cell or one column header.
    CellRange
    Rectangular block of cells in view coordinates, all bounds inclusive.
    CellRenderer
    Paints the content of one cell, like Swing's TableCellRenderer, but draws directly instead of returning a component.
    CellRendererProvider
    Picks the renderer per cell, for example by row or by value.
    CellRenderers
    Built-in renderers, factories for formatted text, and text helpers for custom renderers.
    CellStyle
    Immutable style of a cell or a column header.
    CellStyleProvider
    Picks a style per cell.
    ColumnGroup
    One row of column groups above the column headers, see Grid.columnGroupsProperty(): the name of the group a model column belongs to at this level, or null for none.
    ComputedGridModel

    A model whose values come from a function, so any size costs no memory:

    GridModel times = new ComputedGridModel(1_000, 1_000, (row, column) -> (row + 1) * (column + 1))
        .columnNames(column -> "x " + (column + 1))
        .rowNames(row -> "y " + (row + 1));
    ComputedGridModel.Values
    Computes the value of a cell.
    Grid
    A table that paints all cells into one canvas: one canvas and two scroll bars, however many rows and columns the model has.
    Grid.CellVisitor
    Receives the selected cells of Grid.forEachSelectedCell(Grid.CellVisitor).
    GridCell
    A cell in view coordinates (as shown) and model coordinates (in the data), with its value.
    GridColumn
    One column of a Grid, addressed by its model index: its width and the limits for it, visibility, renderer and header.
    GridLayout
    What a user arranged in a grid: column order, widths and visibility, sorting, frozen columns and rows, and zoom.
    GridLayout.ColumnRange
    Consecutive model columns, shown next to each other in this order.
    GridModel
    The data shown by a Grid: a rectangle of values addressed by row and column.
    GridModelEvent
    Describes a change in a GridModel.
    GridModelEvent.Type
    What changed.
    GridModelListener
    Notified when a GridModel changes.
    GridSelectionModel
    Rectangular ranges of view cells plus an anchor and a focused cell, which is always one cell.
    ListGridModel<T>
    A model for a list of objects, one object per row and one column per getter.
    PagedGridModel<T>
    A model for data that is too large or too slow to load at once, such as a database table or a remote service.
    PagedGridModel.PageLoader<T>
    Loads one page of items, on a background thread.
    PagedGridModel.PageRequest
    What the loader should load.
    PagedGridModel.SortColumn
    One column of a PagedGridModel.PageRequest's sort order.
    RowFilters
    Ready-made row filters for Grid.setRowFilter(IntPredicate).
    RowHeightProvider
    Gives rows their own height, e.g.
    SelectionMode
    What a click selects and how Shift and Ctrl extend it.
    SortKey
    One column of a sort order: rows are sorted by a list of these, the first one decides and the next ones break its ties.
    TextMetrics
    Fast text measurement with the same rules the grid uses to cut and wrap text, e.g.
    TreeGrid
    A Grid for a TreeGridModel: the first model column shows each item indented by its depth, with a triangle that expands and collapses it.
    TreeGridModel<T>
    A tree of items shown as rows: every item is a row, and the children of an expanded item follow it.
